description: This is a PHP script that handles AJAX requests to update user interface status indicators related to network connectivity, battery charge, WiFi, MoCA, and firewall settings. It retrieves system information, processes it, and outputs a JSON configuration for UI elements.

methods.name: get_tips
methods.description: Generates user-friendly tips or status messages based on the target system component and its current status, such as internet connection, WiFi, MoCA, or firewall.
